<b>Fatal Resolve</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It becomes available after obtaining the [[Needle Strike]] ability and entering [[Act 3]]. It can be acquired from [[Bellhart|Bellhart's]] Wishwall after additionally completing the <i>[[ASCEND: Return to Pharloom]]</i> objective and obtaining the [[Silk Soar]] ability, or directly from a [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Blasted Steps|note]] left by Pinstress in her hut in the [[Blasted Steps]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must find [[Pinstress|Pinstress']] location within [[Mount Fay]]. If the Wish is accepted from the Wishwall, the note in her hut must be read first, to tell Hornet that the Pinstress has gone to Mount Fay. Dead enemies with Pinstress' pins in them are scattered across the area leading to her location, which can be interacted with to track her pathway.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Pinstress Fatal Resolve.png!Pinstress' location in Mount Fay
}}

At this location, Pinstress is sleeping and needs to be hit repeatedly with the [[Needle]] to awaken her. After speaking to her, she challenges Hornet to a duel. Defeating her completes the Wish.

== Reward ==
[[File:Pin Badge.png|link=Pin Badge|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the Wish, Pinstress gifts Hornet the [[Pin Badge]] Tool. It also unlocks the <i>[[Achievements (Silksong)|Fatal Resolve]]</i> Achievement.

{{Clear}}
